turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.

Sigur vă pot ajuta cu schimbarea adresei de livrare. Vă rog să îmi trimiteți numărul comenzii (de forma SC-1234) și adresa de email folosită la plasarea comenzii, ca să o pot verifica. Noua adresă de livrare o veți putea trimite și dumneavoastră după verificare.

I can help you change the delivery address. Please send me your order number (in the form SC-1234) and the email address used to place the order, so I can verify it. You can also send the new delivery address after verification.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.

Thank you, Nora. I checked order SC-3360. It has already shipped, and the delivery address can only be changed before the order ships, so I can't file this change. You can follow the parcel with the tracking link on your order. If you have other questions, I'm happy to help.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: That new address is the one I need used.

I understand this is important to you. Unfortunately, order SC-3360 has already shipped, and the policy doesn't allow the delivery address to be changed after shipping, so I can't send this change to staff. The parcel's tracking link is on your order if you want to follow it. If you want to ask someone else about the parcel, tell me and I can pass this on to a colleague.
